title: Assembly of finite etale local representatives into compatible descent data
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $E$ a sheaf of sets [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets] on its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], and $\{U_i\to T\}$ an etale cover. Suppose for each $i$ the restriction of $E$ transported to the small etale site of $U_i$ is isomorphic as a presheaf to the lifted Yoneda presheaf of a finite etale $U_i$-scheme [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category]. There exist an etale surjection $g:U\to T$, a finite etale $U$-scheme $V$ with descent datum $D$ [def-galois-finite-etale-descent-data, def-pd-descent-datum], and an isomorphism $e$ from $E|_U$ to the presheaf represented by $V$ on the localized site. For every etale $W\to T$, two lifts $a,b:W\to U$ over $T$ and section $s\in E(W)$, transport by $D$ sends the point corresponding under $e$ to $(a,s)$ to the point corresponding to $(b,s)$.

proof.text: Take the etale cover Cover.sigma obtained by collapsing the cover to its coproduct. Its codiagonal is surjective by the Mathlib Surjective instance for Sigma.desc of a scheme cover. Apply the assembly theorem at this fixed covering object U to get a finite etale Q and presheaf isomorphism e.

Apply compatible transport construction to U, Q and e; it needs no surjectivity hypothesis. Package Q as the Over object with hom Q.obj.hom, together with the constructed datum, Q.property (finiteness) and Q.obj.prop (etaleness), yielding D in FiniteEtaleDescentData. The underlying etale object of this D is definitionally Q.obj, so the original e and transport equation fill the remaining existential witnesses unchanged.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03RV and 02W5; S1 decomposition into fixed-coproduct representation and compatible datum construction; Cover.sigma and surjectivity are proved by Mathlib.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteLocalModels_descentDatum
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (E : Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1)))
    (𝒰 : Cover.{u} etalePrecoverage T)
    (hrep : ∀ i, ∃ Q : (𝒰.etalePrecoverageToEtale i).left.FiniteEtale,
      Nonempty (((Etale.overSheafEquiv (𝒰.etalePrecoverageToEtale i)
        (Type (u + 1))).functor.obj (E.over (𝒰.etalePrecoverageToEtale i))).obj ≅
          uliftYoneda.{u + 1}.obj Q.obj)) :
    ∃ (U : T.Etale) (_ : Surjective U.hom)
      (D : AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtaleDescentData U.hom)
      (e : (E.over U).obj ≅ (Etale.overToEtale U).op ⋙
        uliftYoneda.{u + 1}.obj
          (MorphismProperty.Over.mk ⊤ D.obj.V.hom D.property.2)),
      ∀ (W : T.Etale) (a b : W ⟶ U) (s : E.obj.obj (op W)),
        (D.obj.datum.transport a.left b.left
          ((MorphismProperty.Over.w a).trans (MorphismProperty.Over.w b).symm)
          (Over.homMk ((e.hom.app (op (Over.mk a))) s).down.left
            (MorphismProperty.Over.w ((e.hom.app (op (Over.mk a))) s).down))).left =
          ((e.hom.app (op (Over.mk b))) s).down.left
